title: Periodic 12-layer stack for layer-count scaling study
scientific_hypothesis: Increasing periodic pair count from 4 to 6 pairs (8 to 12 layers) improves MWIR stopband depth without degrading LWIR passband transmission, demonstrating layer-count scaling within periodic designs.
design_principle: Bragg reflector stopband depth increases with number of periods. Adding 2 more pairs should deepen MWIR suppression while maintaining LWIR transmission, testing whether intermediate layer counts offer better performance-manufacturability trade-off than 8 or 16 layers.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | Ge substrate (12 layers total, 6 alternating pairs)
design_variables: ZnS layer thickness (applied to all 6 ZnS layers)
ZnSe layer thickness (applied to all 6 ZnSe layers)
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band
Achieve deeper MWIR suppression than 8-layer periodic design
manufacturing_considerations: 12 layers balances performance and manufacturing complexity
Stress accumulation moderate compared to 16-layer design
theory_basis: Bragg reflector stopband depth scales with pair count
Transfer matrix method for periodic multilayers
expected_advantages: Lower stress and complexity than 16-layer design
known_risks: May not provide significant improvement over 8 layers for this spectral requirement
LWIR transmission ripples may increase with more periods
execution_request_english: Optimize a periodic 12-layer multilayer film on Ge (Icenogle) substrate with air incidence. Stack order: Air | ZnS | ZnSe (Querry) | ZnS | ZnSe (Querry) | ZnS | ZnSe (Querry) | ZnS | ZnSe (Querry) | ZnS | ZnSe (Querry) | ZnS | ZnSe (Querry) | Ge (Icenogle). Two design variables: thickness_ZnS applies to layers 1,3,5,7,9,11; thickness_ZnSe (Querry) applies to layers 2,4,6,8,10,12. Wavelength bands: 8000-11000 nm (maximize transmittance), 3000-5000 nm (minimize transmittance). Total layers fixed at 12. Materials: zns, ZnSe (Querry), Ge (Icenogle). Find thickness values that maximize LWIR transmission while suppressing MWIR with 6 periodic pairs.
